06GWD SPORTS · PARTNERS

Their IT and digital partner.

We are the IT and digital partner behind these organisations — the academy management system and the tournament operating system both run on infrastructure GWD built from scratch. Not a white-labelled product, not a template: to our knowledge it is the first end-to-end digital simulation of a grassroots sports operation in India, covering registration, attendance, fees, live standings, and the tournament itself, in one connected system.
